reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthActionCategories selection with an options flag that five actions use, but copyPreviousMonth keeps and patches its own inline exclusion list.

duplication.why: The include-hidden decision is implemented twice: as a parameterised SQL condition in getMonthActionCategories and as a JS condition in copyPreviousMonth; the argument type is also repeated in six signatures.

placement.why: The rule lives in the month-action category selection in budget/actions.ts, except copyPreviousMonth, which still decides exclusions in its own loop.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the selection helper, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A single option on the shared selection with a safe default; the hidden rule in copyPreviousMonth and the repeated inline argument types leave room for drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden/group-hidden exclusion (now with the flag) inline instead of via getMonthActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The include-hidden rule appears as '(? = 1 OR (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0))' in SQL and as '!includeHiddenCategories && (hidden || group_hidden)' in copyPreviousMonth.
